observation_notes: Fully paginated open PRs and matching live branch refs captured after #355 was retargeted to #354.
These endpoints were observed separately, not as an atomic GitHub transaction.
Snapshot excludes the later publication branch/PR for this reconciliation report itself.

qualification.note: No tests, CI, review, semantic equivalence, readiness or ownership release is inferred by this inventory.

interpretation.branch_delta: Changes from the unique merge base of pinned main and the branch head to that head. No delta is inferred for unrelated or multiple-merge-base histories.
interpretation.pr_delta: Changes from the unique merge base of the pinned PR base and head to that head; no mutable ref is used.
interpretation.postimages: Every changed path must have the same final blob, mode and type, including absence for deletions. Matching postimages do not establish patch provenance or semantic completeness.
interpretation.history: Ancestry proves historical inclusion, not preservation of behavior after later changes or reversions.
interpretation.ownership: Full raw claim documents are indexed by blob SHA and source commit. Their text and status remain uninterpreted; changed paths and overlaps do not establish ownership.
interpretation.documentation: Only narrative .md/.rst/.adoc/.txt under docs and root README/LICENSE/NOTICE are excluded from the non-documentation overlap list. Code, JSON, MDX and assets under docs remain included.
interpretation.snapshots: An inventory can span different endpoint times. Base/head SHA mismatches remain visible; this tool does not substitute later branch tips.
